package.description: CLI tool which enables you to login and retrieve AWS temporary credentials using a SAML IDP

en-US.description: CLI tool which enables you to login and retrieve AWS temporary credentials using a SAML IDP
en-US.longDescription:
CLI tool which enables you to login and retrieve AWS temporary credentials using with ADFS or PingFederate Identity Providers.
This is based on python code from How to Implement a General Solution for Federated API/CLI Access Using SAML 2.0.
The process goes something like this:
- Setup an account alias, either using the default or given a name
- Prompt user for credentials
- Log in to Identity Provider using form based authentication
- Build a SAML assertion containing AWS roles
- Optionally cache the SAML assertion (the cache is not encrypted)
- Exchange the role and SAML assertion with AWS STS service to get a temporary set of credentials
- Save these credentials to an aws profile named "saml"
en-US.name: saml2aws

zh-CN.description: 允许通过 SAML 身份提供商登录并获取 AWS 临时凭证的命令行工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
允许通过 ADFS 或 PingFederate 身份提供商登录并获取 AWS 临时凭证的命令行工具。
该工具基于《How to Implement a General Solution for Federated API/CLI Access Using SAML 2.0（如何使用 SAML 2.0 实现联邦 API/CLI 访问的通用解决方案）》中的 Python 代码实现。
流程如下：
- 设置账户别名（使用默认名称或指定名称）
- 提示用户输入凭据
- 通过表单认证登录身份提供商
- 构建包含 AWS 角色的 SAML 断言
-（可选）缓存 SAML 断言（缓存未加密）
- 将角色和 SAML 断言与 AWS STS 服务交换，获取临时凭证
- 将这些凭证保存至名为“saml”的 AWS 配置文件中
